name: Horizontal tabs (legacy services)
purpose: Breaks a service offering into 5 stages the visitor can click through, each with a short pitch and a photo.
description: Legacy hairline-framed block (/lms/professional-services, green colours hard-coded). A row of 5 equal tab links (24px labels); the current tab gets a green bottom border and a soft radial glow. Below, one pane split 50/50: 32px H3 + grey paragraph with one bold phrase | a photo (6.835:5.23). No section header. <=767 tabs wrap 2-up with 16px labels and the pane stacks with a 3:2 image.
